mc_unit: dataset (one shared phenotype/genotype draw; SNP rows are not independent MC replicates)

targets.scientific: expstress cells use generative conditional mean coefficient a and log-SD coefficient b in s(g)=s0*exp(b*g/s0), with s0=1; their shipped beta_sigma2 target is the local variance coefficient 2*b. normal_linear cells use E[Y|g]=a*(g-2p), Var[Y|g]=1+v*(g-2p), with scientific targets a and v; cov_both SNP targets are exactly zero conditional on C
targets.projection: population slope of the shipped Stage-1 RIF after the named preprocessing, then projection onto the fitted W; exact for regular cells up to Truth background MC and reference-MC for cov_both
